summary.text: Sarah Puckett is the Democratic candidate for Missouri House of Representatives District 118 in the November 3, 2026 general election, running against Republican Amy DeClue.
Puckett is a project director and Franklin County resident who, in a Ballotpedia survey, lists opposition to AI data centers, abortion rights and health care among her priorities.

paragraphs.text: Sarah Puckett graduated from North Miami Beach Senior High School, and her career experience includes working as a project director.

In a Ballotpedia survey, Puckett said she has lived in Franklin County for five years and lives in Grubville, and that after growing up in Missouri she lived in South Florida, California and Washington State before returning.
She described her focus as farm life, self-sufficiency and responsible farming, and said she has fostered Catahoula dogs.
Puckett listed opposition to AI data centers, support for women's rights and access to abortion, and support for Medicaid for all as her key campaign messages.
She also named education funding among her policy interests and said she opposes the sales tax increase in Amendment 5.
